# ABCJS

- Source: https://github.com/paulrosen/abcjs
- Distribution: `abcjs@6.7.0`, `dist/abcjs-basic-min.js` from the official npm package.
- Local filename: `abcjs-basic-6.7.0.min.js` (unmodified).
- SHA-256: `b0cde4bc52bb33949181683a245005fff8a024a8c1f07ec6ce3222cd4bd72e51`.
- License: MIT, retained in `LICENSE.md`.

Loaded lazily from the app itself; no CDN, telemetry or external soundfont loading.
Only score rendering and binary MIDI export are used, not synthesized playback.
